name: Karaka
description: A star 40 parsecs away, 87% of the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 76351: radius 0.872 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 0.493 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.049) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 76351: effective temperature 5185 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.027)

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 76351: distance 40.34 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.009), at which the luminosity and radius hold

limb.none: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15)

text.card: A star 40 parsecs away, 87% of the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 0.493 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,185 K, so 0.872 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 76351: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: HD 137388
quotes.card: HD 137388 is an orange-hued star in the southern constellation of Apus.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Karaka, after the native New Zealand karaka tree.
